definitions.explanation: Describes something with limited space or area. The opposite of {広|ひろ}い (wide, spacious). Used for rooms, roads, areas, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狭|せま}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{狭|せま}い⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らないで→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't enter the narrow road.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狭|せま}くて⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: It's so cramped here I can't move.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狭|せま}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{一|ひと}{人|り}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This room is small, but it's enough for living alone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アパート→あぱーと：01012_apaato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狭|せま}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われています→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らせます→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Japanese apartments are said to be small, but with some ingenuity you can live comfortably. It's important to use storage space well.

notes:
{狭|せま}い is an i-adjective describing limited space or area.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {狭|せま}く (narrowly)
- Noun form: {狭|せま}さ (narrowness)
- Te-form: {狭|せま}くて

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{狭|せま}い: the room is cramped
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{狭|せま}い: the road is narrow
- {狭|せま}い⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: tight/cramped space

METAPHORICAL USE:
- ⟦{視野|しや}→視野：08659_shiya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{狭|せま}い: narrow-minded (lit. narrow field of vision)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{狭|せま}い: petty, small-minded

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide, spacious)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese apartments are often described as {狭|せま}い, reflecting typical urban housing constraints.
